# Caching errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Patterns.Caching.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama5100> | The [InvalidateCache] aspect names a method that isn't cached. |
| <xref:lama5101> | The invalidating method can't provide the instance that's part of the cache key of the invalidated method. |
| <xref:lama5102> | A parameter of the invalidated method has no parameter of the same name in the invalidating method. |
| <xref:lama5103> | A parameter of the invalidating method has a type that isn't compatible with the matching parameter of the cached method. |
| <xref:lama5104> | A method name passed to [InvalidateCache] is null, empty, or whitespace. |
| <xref:lama5105> | The [InvalidateCache] aspect doesn't name any method to invalidate. |
| <xref:lama5106> | The [InvalidateCache] aspect names a method that doesn't exist in the searched type. |
| <xref:lama5107> | The method name passed to [InvalidateCache] matches several suitable overloads. |
| <xref:lama5108> | Informational message showing which [InvalidateCache] method invalidates a cached method (not currently reported). |
| <xref:lama5109> | Informational message showing which cached method an [InvalidateCache] method invalidates (not currently reported). |
| <xref:lama5110> | A static method uses caching while caching is configured to use dependency injection. |
| <xref:lama5111> | A parameter classifier marked a parameter of a cached method as ineligible. |
